newsitem.title: UK: Britannic soars after special bonus news.
newsitem.headline: Britannic soars after special bonus news.

text.p: Shares in Britannic Assurance Plc jumped 51-1/2p to 855 by 0815 GMT in pre-market trade after the company said it had identified 902 million stg of assets as wholly attributable to shareholders.
Britannic also declared a special bonus of 209 million stg, details of which will be announced with the 1996 bonus to be declared next month.
"The bonus payout is what's driving the shares. It's a good deal for shareholders," one market maker said..
The groups said at the end of 1995 the total assets in its life funds were 5.682 billion stg.
Out of the total assets, 4.70 billion stg is attributable to the profit funds while another 79 million stg to non-profit funds.
